title: Agent orchestration and durable workflows
subtitle: Coordinate steps, parallel work, state, approvals, and recovery.
goal: Coordinate dependent and parallel work without losing ownership
intro: Orchestration makes the relationship between steps, state, and recovery visible.
terms: A result needed before another step
flow: Persist progress or ask for review
case: Search three permitted corpora while a separate approval step waits.
Independent reads can run together; the write cannot start before review.
Parallel work can overload providers or hide partial failures.
